observed_in: Pet and Companion System failure analysis

definition: If the management of companions is overly complex or unintuitive, players may ignore the mechanic entirely, leading to underutilization of a core feature. This can make the game feel less immersive and strategic.
exclusion_criteria: companions are easy to manage and understand
inclusion_criteria: players do not engage with the companion system
companion mechanics are confusing and convoluted
title: Neglected Companion Mechanics
